answer: In a market for dawn sound surveys around willow trees, a whisper copied across a thousand agents must not earn a thousand payments. Limit rewards to one claim per certified sensor per epoch. Its tamper-resistant chip signs the epoch and reading; validators check the certificate and reject repeated sensor-epoch pairs across all accounts. An audited registry must prevent duplicate device enrollment. More aliases add no allowance: scaling requires buying and deploying additional certified hardware, not merely generating keys.
